acceptance.criterion: Calibrated AUROC and AUPRC exceed baseline, and calibrated Brier score is lower.

baseline.method: DummyClassifier with the training-set class prior.
baseline.name: prevalence_only

calibrated_model.method: Extra Trees with three-fold isotonic calibration on training rows.
calibrated_model.name: calibrated_extra_trees

interpretation: On this deterministic synthetic fixture, the calibrated model improves discrimination and Brier score over the prevalence-only baseline.

leakage_checks.detail: Synthetic row identifiers are disjoint across fit and evaluation sets.
Feature contract excludes the generated target column.
Cross-validation and isotonic fitting use training rows only.

limitations: Synthetic labels are a deterministic function of same-row features, so apparent discrimination and calibration are easier than real-world prediction.
Rows have no patient, site, subgroup, or temporal structure. The split checks row overlap only and cannot test patient-level or temporal leakage.
No confidence intervals, subgroup analysis, drift analysis, or external validation is available from this fixture.
Alert burden counts independently scored rows. It does not model repeated alerts, suppression windows, staffing, workflow, or intervention effects.
These results do not estimate clinical performance and must not guide care.

reproduction.calibration: Three-fold isotonic calibration within training rows only.
reproduction.ece: Expected calibration error across fixed-width probability bins.
reproduction.split: Seeded stratified 75/25 row holdout before model fitting.

scope.excluded_uses: Clinical-device evaluation, care guidance, and patient-level inference.
scope.purpose: Reproducibility evidence for the public synthetic research demo only.
